accounting.rationale: Original PDF131 lines4-5 describes pointer association and the data/procedure categories. It neither establishes a target nor creates a mandatory no-op declaration test.
The POINTER attribute is an entity property, distinct from a target's properties and from a containing object's pointer components.
PENDING canonical allocation, pointer-assignment and argument mechanisms for changing association under their full conditions. No new association event or representation model is inferred.
The described execution-time possibility does not establish initial status. Explicit/default initialization and undefined initial association keep their actual19.5.2 rules.

Data pointer targets must satisfy their canonical type/kind/rank/parameter, target, image and lifetime conditions; arbitrary expressions or undefined targets are not interchangeable with compatible live objects.
Procedure targets retain characteristic, interface, eligibility and host-instance conditions. A pointer entity's attributes are not automatically attributes required of its target.

A pointer is a data pointer or a procedure pointer; this is not permission for one declared entity to alternate between those categories. Definition status, association status and procedure invocation remain separate.
Preserve the named-procedure subject. A data-pointer function result, procedure-pointer component and pointed-to procedure are not silently substituted for the named pointer entity.
EXTERNAL can be specified by a qualifying interface body or procedure declaration; absence of an EXTERNAL keyword is not proof of attribute absence.

PDF131 lines9-10 distinguishes value reference with a defined target from value definition with a definable target. Pointer-association operations and permitted property inquiries are not collapsed into either.
PDF131 line13 governs procedure reference/invocation, not every appearance of a procedure-pointer designator.
The actual unnumbered note on PDF131 gives two data-pointer declaration examples. No procedure invocation, allocation, association or value is established by them.
CURRENT and TAIL require a valid prior NODE type definition. Their declarations do not establish association or permit a value reference.

The REAL pointer arrays have rank2 and deferred shape; IN, OUT and SWAP are entity names here, not INTENT specifications. C834 remains the ordinary-array owner and no physical-layout inference is made.

requirements.title: A POINTER entity excludes three other attributes and coarray status
requirements.definition: An entity with POINTER has none of ALLOCATABLE, INTRINSIC or TARGET and is not a coarray. These are properties of that entity, not prohibitions on a compatible allocated target, an eligible intrinsic procedure target or pointer components inside other objects.

pending.allocatable-conflict: PENDING an ordinary INTEGER scalar declared with both POINTER and ALLOCATABLE, repaired by removing just one attribute. Use no initialization or association/data use to introduce another defect. A separately qualified array variant must already meet the canonical shape rules.
pending.intrinsic-conflict-source: PENDING a genuinely intrinsic named procedure given POINTER, with a complete otherwise valid procedure context and a non-INTRINSIC pointer repair. Explicitly adjudicate C842/C855 and declaration-route overlap before selecting one canonical negative; a nonintrinsic name in an INTRINSIC statement or a grammar error is not this predicate.
pending.target-conflict-owner: PENDING an ordinary scalar POINTER/TARGET declaration with a one-attribute repair. C866 states the reciprocal incompatibility: retain one canonical cause/owner relationship rather than duplicate equivalent negatives or pretend the two constraints describe independent phenomena.
pending.coarray-conflict: PENDING a main-program INTEGER scalar pointer with an explicit coarray specification, repaired only by removing that specification. Main-program variable SAVE and all other C823/C826 conditions must actually hold. Unsupported coarray configuration is not a causal pointer/coarray report or a license for a fabricated capability skip.
pending.distinct-target-controls: PENDING source-qualified separate POINTER p and live TARGET t, allocated allocatable targets under their actual TARGET/state rules, and eligible intrinsic procedure targets. The pointer object must not acquire the target's attributes merely by association. No new address/layout or allocation-effect owner.
pending.scalar-array-component-source: PENDING actual scalar/array/assumed-rank/result/component roles. Keep C750/C754 component-array grammar and C834 ordinary-array rules separate; a pointer component does not make its parent a pointer, and an IN data-pointer dummy receiving a nonpointer actual is not an unqualified general rule.

requirements.oracle: Focused ordinary-entity incompatibilities with minimal valid repairs and explicit canonical-overlap gates. Complete role and attribute premises precede diagnostic attribution.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Required reporting does not prescribe fatal exit, English text or a printed code. No duplicate canonical case, unsupported-feature/configuration credit, source echo, unrelated type/rank error, ICE or source-span workaround. Merely listing a source relation does not approve a connection.

requirements.title: A named procedure pointer has the EXTERNAL attribute
requirements.definition: A named procedure that has POINTER has EXTERNAL. The attribute can be conferred by the actual declaration mechanism, not only by an explicit EXTERNAL keyword. The named pointer entity is distinct from its target; a data-pointer result is not the function procedure entity, and procedure-pointer components retain their own declaration rules.

pending.pointer-statement-external: PENDING a complete named procedure-pointer declaration using explicit EXTERNAL and POINTER statements, with a compatible procedure interface if invoked. R856/R857/C892 retain the pointer-statement owner; no call/link failure proves the attribute.
pending.procedure-declaration-external: PENDING PROCEDURE(interface),POINTER::p in a complete context.15.4.3.6p1 supplies EXTERNAL even without that keyword; such a declaration is not a missing-EXTERNAL negative.
pending.interface-body-external: PENDING a valid specific/generic interface-body route declaring the same named procedure-pointer entity, preserving15.4.3.2p5 and all characteristic/attribute conditions. Do not use a module procedure definition or unrelated abstract interface as if it supplied the entity's EXTERNAL attribute.
pending.named-role-and-negative-gate: PENDING a source-isolated negative only after establishing a named procedure-pointer role that lacks EXTERNAL without an alternative valid data-pointer parse or an already sufficient declaration. C892 overlap, procedure-pointer components and data-pointer function results are explicit gates. A missing word or unresolved symbol is not proof; any repair must confer the actual attribute and leave a complete valid role.

requirements.oracle: Complete declaration-mechanism admissions and a finite role/owner gate for any proposed omission negative. No isolated violation is claimed merely from keyword absence.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No universal explicit-keyword requirement, target-procedure EXTERNAL requirement, component grammar expansion, link-error oracle or diagnostic-policy shortcut. Precise legitimate origins and case-specific causes are required without coalescing lines or widening spans.

requirements.title: Data-pointer value reference and definition require distinct valid target states
requirements.definition: A data-pointer value is referenced only while the pointer is associated with a defined target object. Defining the value through a data pointer instead requires association with a definable target. Association/status operations and permitted property inquiries are distinct; association alone does not make the target's payload defined or definable.

pending.defined-target-reference: PENDING a complete valid control with live INTEGER TARGET t defined as17, compatible p=>t, a one-argument ASSOCIATED guard and a literal17 value check. If later p=19 is observed through t, retain legal ownership and aliasing; no address or copy model is used.
pending.undefined-target-definition-control: PENDING a live ordinary INTEGER target not yet given a value, followed by p=>t and then p=17 before any data read. Association can be checked without reading payload; assignment defines the definable target and later literal17 reads are valid. Do not query or print the previous undefined value.
pending.unassociated-source-contrasts: PENDING source-only invalid read/definition through an explicitly NULLIFYed pointer, with a minimally repaired valid control associating it with an already suitable live target first. Do not execute the invalid access, demand a trap or invent a required prose report; a rejection fixture needs a separate justified diagnostic basis/policy.
pending.not-definable-target-source: PENDING exact INTENT, PROTECTED and dummy-aliasing restrictions on target definability. INTENT(IN) of a pointer concerns association, not an unconditional ban on target definition; conversely association does not make an IN nonpointer target definable. Keep canonical owners and do not use an independently forbidden data-target as an allegedly isolated local contrast.
pending.zero-size-length-and-inquiry-boundary: PENDING 19.6.2's always-defined zero-size arrays/zero-length strings separately from presence, allocation and pointer association. Valid associated empty targets can use permitted inquiries, but no nonexistent element is read and no zero-byte representation is inferred. RANK/nondeferred LEN and ASSOCIATED have distinct contracts; ASSOCIATED rejects undefined association status and its two-argument zero-size result is not a universal association-status oracle.

requirements.oracle: Meaningful, state-valid positive controls and explicit source/policy gates for nonconforming contrasts. Literal data results are observed only after association and the exact target-value/definability premises are established.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No blanket required prose diagnostic, undefined-value test, guessed default association, absent/unallocated/dangling read, or hidden lifetime/SAVE repair. Existing assignment/argument/component witnesses retain their original roles; no source-use credit or positive-control opt-in is inferred.

requirements.title: Associated data pointers have their target's corresponding deferred type-parameter values
requirements.definition: When a data pointer is associated, each deferred type-parameter value equals the corresponding value of its target. This is a target relationship, not an assumption of argument association, current target payload definition or arbitrary kind conversion. Deferred result-type characteristics of a function or function procedure pointer are distinct from the actual values of an associated data-pointer result.

pending.character-parameter-reuse: PENDING exact runtime-effect reuse review of S7_2_004_valid__pointer_assignment, which associates a deferred-length CHARACTER pointer with live length2 and length5 targets and checks literal LEN/value results. Preserve the S7.2-004 owner, source, role and receipt; no cloned program or approved link is created by this plan.
pending.pdt-parameter-reuse: PENDING the corresponding source relation for S7_2_004_valid__pointer_assignment_pdt: the deferred LEN parameter follows live targets with n=2 and5 while the nondeferred kind family remains compatible. Actual scalar/PDT/component roles are retained; do not infer an array-pointer bound effect or narrow an arbitrary kind identifier.
pending.associated-undefined-payload-boundary: PENDING a live default-CHARACTER length2 target whose characters are initially undefined, and a deferred-length data pointer associated with it. A permitted LEN inquiry can observe literal2 without payload use; define the target through the pointer before any character-value read. This is a real associated-parameter effect, not a definition-status probe.
pending.inactive-nondeferred-procedure-boundarie: PENDING canonical inactive-state and fixed-parameter boundaries. Deferred LEN is not queried while disassociated, although the specific LEN contract can permit a nondeferred length inquiry. KIND cannot be made deferred by this paragraph; nondeferred matching remains10.2.2.3. Under7.2 NOTE1 a function's deferred result-type characteristic has no current value; execution can establish an associated data-pointer result with actual target-derived values. Do not erase that result/entity distinction.

requirements.oracle: Actual run/effect observations of associated data pointers with independent literal target-parameter expectations, preferably through qualified canonical reuse. Target liveness, type/kind/rank/parameter compatibility and specific inquiry conditions are explicit prerequisites.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No compile-only substitute for required effects, fixed kind code, storage layout, target-address or affected-descriptor self-oracle. A valid IN pointer-dummy/nonpointer-actual route has separate rules and no fabricated effective argument. No source/role/link approval is granted here.

requirements.title: A procedure-pointer invocation requires association with a target procedure
requirements.definition: A procedure pointer is referenced only when it is associated with a target procedure. Under5.4.5, procedure reference means execution; a permitted status inquiry, association operation or unevaluated procedure-designator actual is not automatically such an invocation. Characteristic compatibility and target/host lifetime still apply.

pending.associated-call-control: PENDING a complete compatible procedure-pointer association to a live module/external procedure followed by a meaningful literal-result call. Existing S7_5_4_6_005_valid__initialization_procedure_local and S10_2_1_3_024_valid already contain qualified procedure-component calls; preserve their actual component/initialization/assignment owners and effect roles, with any reuse separately source/role-adjudicated rather than cloned or retagged.
pending.disassociated-call-source: PENDING a source-only invocation of an explicitly NULLIFYed procedure pointer, repaired by associating the same pointer with a compatible live target before the call. Do not execute the invalid invocation, use a crash as evidence or invent a mandatory prose rejection; any diagnostic policy needs separate justification.
pending.status-and-argument-contexts: PENDING exact ASSOCIATED and dummy-procedure/procedure-pointer argument rules. A defined disassociated status can be inquired about; an undefined status cannot. Passing a designator need not invoke it, but argument evaluation, recipient attributes, presence and association still have their own constraints.
pending.characteristics-lifetime-target-source: PENDING explicit/implicit interface, function/subroutine/result characteristics, intrinsic-target eligibility and host-instance lifetime under10.2.2.4/15.5.2.10/19.5.2.5. A named pointer's EXTERNAL attribute is not required of every target, and an intrinsic target does not give the pointer INTRINSIC. Never mask a dead internal-procedure target by adding SAVE or manufacture a call after its host completes.

requirements.oracle: Complete associated-call controls with independent known results and finite source/policy gates for prohibited invocation states. Original callable witnesses keep their owners, roles and qualified observations.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No all-name-use ban, forced fatal status, generic missing-symbol/link oracle, undefined-call experiment or unqualified role transfer. No descriptor, C address, byte representation or copy/allocator strategy is used as evidence.

review_rationale: Independent complete original-source reviewf184f560187e7109978337aeb412f48049b278bda8c16bd7bc688aec0bd6dc5c, registered in doc/source_audits/batch_058.json. All7base/28fine units,five requirements and23pending facets preserve exact POINTER-entity exclusions and named procedure-pointer EXTERNAL routes. Declaration, association status, target definition/definability, deferred parameters, invocation and lifetime are distinct. Legitimate PROCEDURE/interface declarations can already supply EXTERNAL; missing keyword spelling is not an isolated C855cause. IN-pointer/nonpointer-actual and zero-size/zero-length rules do not waive presence, association, target, aliasing or inquiry conditions. Existing parameter/assignment/initialization effects remain only candidates for separate reuse; no role retagging, undefined-value trap, address/ABI or runtime coverage is inferred.
